segments.contextBefore: Shape a physics body to your graphics for the right blend of collision accuracy and performance.
segments.contextAfter: In most cases, a physics body should have a size and shape that closely approximates the visual representation of the corresponding node.

segments.source: **Swift**:
segments.normalizedSource: **Swift**:
segments.contextBefore: If you do not want to create your own shapes, you can use SpriteKit to create a shape for you based on the sprite’s texture.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let sprite = SKSpriteNode(imageNamed: "Spaceship")
sprite.physicsBody = SKPhysicsBody(texture: sprite.texture!,
                                   size: sprite.texture!.size())
```
